dct_title_s: Bahamas - Draft subdivisions for Grand Bahama Island
dct_description_sm: Draft Subdivisions for Grand Bahama, showing draft subdivisions by jurisdiction. The boundaries, designations and names used on this map do not imply official endorsement or acceptance by the Shelter Cluster. This is a draft produced for programmatic and planning purposes, it will be updated as soon as possible. The boundaries for Grand Bahama Port Authority (GBPA) on this shapefile are approved. Other boundaries are draft boundaries. Any areas labelled "private" are partially under jurisdiction of GBPA depending on the activity.
